THE LEIBISH COLLECTIONS

  • LEIBISH & GALIA LAHAV

    A Union of Artistry and Emotion. When two worlds of craftsmanship and couture meet, something extraordinary is born. LEIBISH, celebrated for its mastery of rare diamonds and bespoke high jewelry, and Galia Lahav, renowned for her haute couture bridal creations, unite in a collaboration that redefines modern romance.

  • LEIBISH LOVE

    An expression of our ultimate love of color, revel in a symphony of whimsical colors, shapes, and sizes. Each unique piece is a dazzling expression of passion and creativity. Brighten your life and shine like a diamond.

  • ZIA

    The Leibish insignia is discreetly concealed within the under galley of these classic designs. These pieces are not only a stunning adornment but also a treasured symbol of family pride, craftsmanship, and enduring legacy.

  • LEGACY

    The sleek linear elegance of the Leibish insignia is inspired by three “L”s representing the past, present, and future of this family-owned business. Every line of the emblem showcases a tantalizing display of brilliance, expressing ultimate sophistication and grace.

  • CASCADE

    A treasure trove of exquisite jewels that celebrate a women’s unique beauty and strength. Elegantly arranged in an alternating zigzag motif, these gems symbolize the multifaceted nature of femininity - bold, adventurous, elegant, and sophisticated.
    A reminder of the treasure that lies within every woman.

  • ROSIE'S BLOOM

    Indulge in a garden of captivating colors, each stone showcased within a bouquet of colorless round brilliants. Enjoy the vibrant allure of nature's own creations.

  • HARMONY

    A love for geometric shapes and patterns are the inspiration behind this majestic interplay of color and composition. Our designer, Chavi Itzhakov, brings this concept to life with exceptional class & craftsmanship.

LEIBISH RESPONSIBLE SOURCING

At LEIBISH, responsibility is our heritage.
We believe true luxury never compromises on ethics. Every diamond is sourced with integrity, crafted with care, and designed to shine for generations.
As proud members of the Responsible Jewellery Council, and with team members engaged in initiatives like the Young Diamantaires, we are committed to shaping a transparent, ethical, and sustainable future for the diamond industry.

Read Our Conflict Free Diamonds Policy

Bring Your Dream Jewelry to Life with Leibish Fancy Color Diamonds & Gemstones

THE LEIBISH COMMITMENT

HANDPICKED SELECTION

Each stone is meticulously chosen by our experts. Only a handful of the world's stones possess the necessary criteria to be added to our collection.

EXPERT CUTTERS

Cutting Fancy Color Diamonds is an art form, which only a select few have mastered. Our second generation diamond cutters understand exactly how gems are formed and are true experts in maximizing the color potential of the rough.

OUTSTANDING CRAFTSMANSHIP

Each piece of jewelry is tailor made to perfectly fit the diamond or gemstone chosen by the client. Each piece is handcrafted by our experts to achieve the highest level of perfection.

COMPLIMENTARY SHIPPING

Enjoy complimentary shipping on all orders for a seamless shopping experience

EXPERT PERSONALIZED SERVICE

Take your shipping journey to take next level with our dedicated client care team

SATISFACTION GUARANTEE

Experience peace of mind with our 30-Day Return Policy and Lifetime Warranty

INTEREST FREE INSTALLMENTS

Use your favorite credit card to split your payment into smaller, bite-sized pieces for free.

LEIBISH Loyalty Club

Join the LEIBISH Loyalty Club and earn reward points on every purchase. Redeem for discounts on future purchases.

REFER A FRIEND

Share the luxury of Leibish and earn rewards: Get $500 when your friend makes their first purchase—and they’ll get $500 off their first order too.
